description: Evidence-bounded reusable roles, supplied Brain-rule selection, capability and delegation requests, workload and quality monitoring, and safe suspend or retire proposals.

routing.when_to_use: Use for a workforce matter requiring a reusable role, applicable supplied Brain rule, bounded capability request, domain delegation, workload or quality review, or owner-review suspension/retirement proposal.
when_not_to_use: Do not activate, suspend, retire, schedule, grant, or supervise an agent.
Do not replace Brain rule governance, Platform grants, Program Ledger, credentials, private memory, or a consumer workforce runtime.

required_inputs.name: source_evidence
required_inputs.description: Explicit synthetic, redacted, or public evidence

required_inputs.name: mode
required_inputs.description: Role, rule, capability, delegation, monitoring, quality, or proposal mode

optional_inputs.name: capability_requests
optional_inputs.description: Bounded capability or skill assignment requests

optional_inputs.name: proposals
optional_inputs.description: Training, review, suspend, or retire proposals

expected_outputs.name: workforce_review
expected_outputs.description: Owner-review workforce envelope with explicit authority and empty effects

forbidden_actions: Activate, suspend, retire, or supervise an agent
Approve Brain rules or technical/capability grants
Copy credentials, private memory, identity, or account bindings
Call connectors, send messages, schedule work, or mutate external state
verification_steps: Check unique workforce reference and evidence namespaces
Validate role, rule, capability, delegation, workload, quality, and proposal references
Keep owner and consumer authority explicit
Confirm all effects and authority flags remain empty/false
completion_criteria: No agent activation, grant, suspension, retirement, credential, private-memory, or external effect is claimed
execution.failure_handling: Return BLOCKED with typed uncertainty and empty nested arrays for authority, privacy, duplicate, or malformed input; return DRAFT for unreported evidence.
